title: आधारभूत तह (कक्षा १-३) मा नेपाली पठन सिप विकासका प्रभावकहरू
nepali: प्रारम्भिक कक्षा पढाइ कार्यक्रमले सम्पूर्ण सिकाइको जगका रूपमा पठन सिपको महत्त्वलाई निर्देश गरेको छ । बालबालिका नै सिकाइ र शिक्षाको गुणस्तर निर्धारणका मूल आधार हुन् । तिनको शैक्षिक गुणस्तरलाई जन्मपूर्व आमाको कोखमा रहँदा पाएको वातावरणदेखि आमाको कोखबाहिर आएपछि पाएको वातावरणले प्रभाव पारेको हुन्छ। सन्तुलित साक्षरता र पठनबोध दक्षताको अभिवृद्धिका लागि बालस्वास्थ्य, बालसुरक्षा र उसले पाएको अवसरका साथै जैविकीय प्रभावले समेत काम गरेको हुन्छ । यसर्थ प्रस्तुत अध्ययन आधारभूत तह (कक्षा १-३) को नेपाली पठन सिप विकासका प्रभावकहरूको खोजीमा केन्द्रित छ । यो अध्ययन गुणात्मक अनुसन्धान विधिमा आधारित छ । यसमा प्राथमिक स्रोत सामग्रीका रूपमा सर्लाही जिल्लाको एउटा सामुदायिक विद्यालयलाई छनोट गरी कक्षा १, २ र ३ को अवलोकन तथा कुराकानीलाई समेत टिपोट गरिएको छ । उक्त कक्षामा अध्यापनरत दुई जना शिक्षिकासँग लिइएको अन्तर्वार्तालाई पठन कार्यकलाप सम्बद्ध सन्दर्भमा उपयोग गरिएको छ भने थप चार जना शिक्षकसँगको अनौपचारिक कुराकानीको टिपोटलाई सन्दर्भगत पुस्ट्याइँका लागि उपयोग गरिएको छ। द्वितीयक स्रोत सामग्रीका रूपमा नेपाल सरकारका दस्तावेजलगायतका अन्य शोधपरक सामग्रीलाई उपयोग गरिएको छ । अध्ययनबाट जैविक तथा मनोवैज्ञानिक प्रभावअन्तर्गत बालमस्तिष्कीय प्रभावले पठन सिप विकासमा आन्तरिक तवरले प्रभाव पार्ने देखियो । त्यस्तै विद्यालय र समुदायले दिएको परिवेशले पठन सिप विकासमा वाह्य रूपमा प्रभाव पारेको देखियो । यसर्थ बालपठन सिप विकासमा यिनै आन्तरिक र बाह्य कारकहरूको प्रभाव रहने निष्कर्ष प्राप्त भयो ।
american_english: The early grade reading programme has indicated the importance of reading skill as the foundation of all learning. Children themselves are the main basis for determining the quality of learning and education. The environment the child receives in the mother's womb before birth and the environment received after coming out of the mother's womb affect its educational quality. For the development of balanced literacy and reading comprehension proficiency, child health, child safety, the opportunities the child gets, as well as biological influence, play a role. Therefore, the present study is focused on the search for the factors influencing the development of Nepali reading skill at the basic level (grades 1-3). This study is based on the qualitative research method. In it, as primary source material, a community school in Sarlahi district was selected and observation and conversation of grades 1, 2 and 3 were also recorded. Interviews taken with two female teachers teaching in that class were used in the context of reading activities, while notes of informal conversations with four additional teachers were used for contextual substantiation. As secondary source material, documents of the Government of Nepal along with other research-based material were used. From the study, under biological and psychological influence, the child-brain influence was seen to affect the development of reading skill in an internal manner. Similarly, the environment provided by the school and community was seen to affect the development of reading skill in an external manner. Therefore, the conclusion was obtained that these very internal and external factors have an influence on the development of child reading skill.

informal_english: Early grade reading programs have shown that reading is the foundation of all learning. Kids themselves are the main basis for how good learning and education turn out. The environment a child gets in the womb before birth and after birth affects how well they do in school. For balanced literacy and reading comprehension, child health, safety, the chances they get, and biology all play a part. So this study zeroes in on what affects Nepali reading skill development in grades 1-3. It's a qualitative study. For primary sources, they picked a community school in Sarlahi district and recorded observations and conversations from grades 1, 2 and 3. Interviews with two female teachers in those classes were used in the reading-activity context, and notes from informal chats with four more teachers were used to back things up. Secondary sources included Government of Nepal documents and other research material. The study found that, under biological and psychological influences, the child's brain affects reading skill development in an internal way. Likewise, the environment the school and community provide affects reading skill development externally. So the takeaway is that these internal and external factors both shape how children develop reading skills.
